name: Leonie Baldock
forbes_bio: Leonie Baldock sold her stake in the Rhodes Ridge iron ore project to Japanese trading and investment company Mitsui In February 2025.
Her sister Alexandra Burt and aunt Angela Bennett also had stakes in the same project and are billionaires.
Her grandfather Peter Wright established a mining partnership with mining magnate Gina Rinehart's father Lang Hancock in the 1950s.
Part of her wealth comes from a stake in Wright Prospecting, a privately owned mining firm based in Perth.
The sisters are embroiled in legal battles with other family members and with mining billionaire Gina Rinehart over royalties from other mines.

name: Harald Link
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2017-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Harald Link is the third-generation head of Thailand's storied B.Grimm group, with interests that include energy, real estate, transport and healthcare.
Founded in 1878 as Siam Dispensary, it was acquired by Link's grandfather Adolf Link in 1914.
After studying in Switzerland and Germany, where he grew up, Link arrived in Bangkok in 1978 to join his uncle in the family firm.
Chief executive since 1987, Link is grooming daughter Caroline to succeed him.
In 2017, Link listed the group's power unit in what was the first ever IPO of a group company. It does business in 14 countries.
forbes_facts: Link is an avid polo player.
His wife is a titled princess of Liechtenstein.
B.Grimm has sponsored the Royal Bangkok Symphony Orchestra.

name: Andrew Tan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Andrew Tan is the chairman of Alliance Global, a holding company with interests in food and beverage, gaming, hospitality and real estate.
The son of a factory worker, Tan built his fortune developing large apartment complexes around Manila.
Alliance Global runs Emperador, the world's largest brandy company by sales volume.
Tan's son Kevin is chief executive of Alliance Global and executive director of property developer Megaworld.
Megaworld is investing 350 billion pesos ($6.3 billion) from 2023 to 2027 to build townships across the Philippines.
forbes_facts: Tan's father splurged on a bottle of brandy at Tan's graduation from the University of the East in 1974; that was Tan's first time trying brandy.

name: Stephanie Haas
forbes_bio: Stephanie Haas is a shareholder In Diehl Stiftung, continuing the legacy of the family-run industrial conglomerate.
The Nuremberg, Germany, based family enterprise is a global technology leader, generating annual sales of more than $5 billion.
The group's diversified portfolio includes strategic sectors such as Metall, Controls, Defence, Aviation, and Hydrometering.
The Diehl Group employs a workforce of more than 18,000 people across its various international divisions.
Originally founded in 1902 as a specialised foundry, the company has evolved over four generations into a major international industrial group.

name: Shirley Kao
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2019-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Shirley Kao owns stakes in Uni-President Enterprises, the food and beverage conglomerate cofounded by her father, Kao Chin-Yen, in 1967.
She was the sole inheritor of her father's fortune after he died in 2016.
She has been a board member at Uni-President since 2013 and heads the group's health and beauty-related subsidiaries.
Her husband, Alex Lo, was promoted to CEO of  the group in 2007 and doubled as its chairman after his father-in-law retired in 2013.
Before Lo turned 60 and stepped down from the CEO post in 2016, he had more than doubled the company's market cap to over $10 billion. He continues to lead the group as chairman.
forbes_facts: Kao and her husband, Alex Lo, were high school sweethearts, but had a second chance at love only after her first marriage failed.
By that time her father was no longer opposed to her marrying a mainland Chinese descendant.

name: Lai Jianping
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2019-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Lai's fortune comes from a minority stake in Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food of China, which makes soy sauce and other condiments.
Lai left the company before it went public in China in 2014.
Haitian originated from an ancient sauce workshop in Foshan, where it produced its first batch of soy sauce more than 400 years ago.

name: Alexander Ramlie
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026)
forbes_bio: Alexander Ramlie is a commissioner of Amman Mineral Internasional, which operates one of the largest copper and gold mines in Indonesia.
Amman Mineral went public in 2023 in a $710 million IPO, the largest in the country in the year.
Ramlie started his career as an investment banker at Lazard Frères & Co., now Lazard, a world-leading financial advisory and asset management firm.
He is also the CEO of Dhilmar, a UK-based mining company which in 2025 acquired the Éléonore gold mine in Canada from U.S. gold giant Newmont for $795 million.

name: Lin Zhixiong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2023); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Lin Zhixiong chairs Double Medical Technology.
Double Medical Technology's main products are trauma implant and spinal implant consumables.
Lin studied at Chiba University in Japan from April 2003 to June 2004.
Lin founded the predecessor of Double Medical Technology after he returned from Japan in 2004.
